data.gender_notes: Chamsia is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Chamsia is derived from the Arabic word 'cham' which means 'moon'. The suffix 'sia' adds the meaning of 'light'. Thus, Chamsia translates to 'moonlight'. This name is a beautiful reminder of the calming and soothing effect of the moon. The name Chamsia carries the meaning “Moonlight” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Chamsia usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chamsia total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
